tasks.instruction: Find the best-rated late-night Korean restaurant in Champaign, IL that opens beyond 9pm on Google Maps.
Get directions to the nearest Bakery that has a rating higher than 4.0 on Google Maps. Stop at the screen showing the route.
Find the best-rated Thai restaurant in Urbana, IL that serves duck cuisine on Google Maps. Review customer comments and compile a summary of positive and negative feedback in Notes.
Find me a Bakery that is within 10min drive near me and does birthday cakes on Google Maps. Find the phone number and create a new note in Notes for that.

Find me a popular Chinese restaurant near Chicago O'Hare airport on Google Maps. Check X for recent posts about their signature dishes and write a summary in Notes. Then get directions to that restaurant on Google Maps. Stop at the screen showing the route.
Find the most-cited paper that cites the paper 'Segment Anything' on Google Scholar. Stop at the screen showing the paper abstract.
Find at least three representative survey papers on LLM agents on Google Scholar, and add their titles to the Notes.

I have some onions, beef, and potatoes in my refrigerator. Can you find me a Chinese-style recipe that uses all three ingredients and can be prepared in under an hour? And find me a video tutorial on YouTube for that. Stop at the screen displaying the video.

Can you check the MacDonald's APP to see if there are any Rewards or Deals including Spicy McCrispy. If so, help me add that to Mobile Order (Do not pay yet, I will do it myself). And then check the pickup location and get directions on Google Maps. Stop at the screen showing the route.
Find three detailed user reviews of the Bose QC45 headphones from Amazon Shopping. Summarize the general sentiment in the Notes.
Find the best deal on a 55-inch 4K OLED TV at Best Buy. Stop at the screen displaying the best deal you find.
Find me a laptop on Amazon Shopping that is under $1000 with an Nvidia GPU and more than 8GB RAM.
Compare the price of a Ninja air fryer 8 qt at Walmart and Amazon Shopping. Stop at the screen displaying the best deal you find.
Check if any of the following items are on sale at Walmart: ribeye steak, fresh oranges, or toilet paper. If any are on sale, add a note in Notes with their prices.

I want to buy a brand-new Nintendo Switch Joy-Con. Any color is fine. Please compare the prices on Amazon Shopping, Walmart, and Best Buy. Find the cheapest option and stop at the screen where I can add it to the cart.
Find the top posts about the game 'Black Myth Wukong' on "X" and summarize the key highlights in Notes.
Check the top 3 trending news on "X". Read a few posts to figure out what's happening. And create a new Note to summarize your findings.
I want to learn how to paint watercolor. Find me some content creators to follow on Lemon8 that has highly liked posts about watercolor painting tutorials. List their account names in Notes.
Check the top 5 trending movies on Fandango that are currently in theaters. Compare their ratings and create a note in Notes for the highest-rated one, including its name and showtimes.
Find me the latest horror movie currently in theaters on Fandango. Check some reviews on Lemon8 about the movie and create a note in Notes with the general sentiment.
Find the cheapest round-trip flight from Chicago to New York City in the next month on Booking. Stop at the screen showing the best deal.
Suggest some interesting things to do in LA. Find the top 3 attractions on Tripadvisor. Save the list in Notes.

Plan a one-day itinerary for Palo Alto, CA using Tripadvisor. Choose the attractions and dining recommendations, but keep in mind that I don't like seafood and I love museums. Write the plan in Notes.
Find a highly recommended local restaurant in Chicago on Tripadvisor. Check the reviews about must-try dishes and summarize in Notes.

Help me find a hotel in Champaign, IL on Booking that is under $200 for a queen bed. Make sure that the rating is higher than 7.0. Double check on Google Maps to see if it is close to the Green Street. Show me your final choice on Booking.

tasks2.Instruction: 我想去北京旅游3天, 帮我生成一个旅游攻略。
来点LLM相关文章。
放一首周传雄的歌。
最近有什么好看的电影。
关注”向前的赵“。
订个五星级酒店。
买一台小米手机。
帮我点一份重庆小面。
Play a song by Wang Leehom.
Open a video about funny things.
How's the weather in Berlin today?
Grab and download an image of the cute emoji.
Tell me if there's any crucial information regarding the US today.
打开高德地图搜索麦当劳, 将第一个麦当劳的位置信息分享给微信好友小明。
打开相册并把第一张照片分享给抖音好友小张。
打开小红书搜索附近饭店推荐并记录饭店名字, 打开大众点评搜索该饭店。
在猫眼查看热映电影并截图, 然后打开微信将截图发送给好友小明, 最后发送消息“你想看什么电影？”。
在应用商店找到射击类游戏, 将评分第3的游戏分享给微信好友小明。
用知乎查找“如何提升职场竞争力”, 将评论最多的文章分享给微信好友小华。
在哔哩哔哩搜索一个西红柿炒蛋教学视频, 将视频发送给wechat群聊”home“。
打开美团搜索奶茶店一点点, 将该店铺发送给微信好友小红。
用美图秀秀美颜相机最新的一张照片, 打开微信将美颜好的照片发送给好友小丽并发送消息“看看这个效果怎么样？”。
打开夸克搜索emo表情包并保存第一个到相册, 打开微信将该图片发表朋友圈, 最后配文“难受的一天”。
打开去哪儿网查找广州一个度假村的信息, 在大众点评查看该度假村的用户评价, 将用户评价记录到备忘录。
在网易云音乐播放张惠妹的掉了并添加到歌单, 将歌曲分享给微信好友小明。
用小红书搜索飞韩国的机票买什么航空公司体验感更好, 点开多个笔记, 根据笔记内容总结出体验感前二好的航空公司并写入备忘录, 根据备忘录信息, 打开携程查询11月1日, 北京-首尔这两个航空公司的机票情况并添加到收藏夹。
在知乎搜索“如何快速提升英语口语”, 总结高赞回答中的有效学习方法并记录到备忘录, 打开抖音搜索相关方法的口语学习视频并收藏。
在京东找三个10000元左右的主机放入购物车, 并在微信发朋友圈配文”这三个主机有什么推荐的吗？“。
在浏览器里面搜索“中国情歌教父是谁？”并打开抖音搜索该歌手的歌曲, 最后将视频分享给微信好友小明。
Find the relevant materials of Mobile-based Agent in Google, and summarize the information content in Notepad.
Open Meitu, select the third photo in the album, beautify the photo and save it.
Open the Rednote to search for matters needing attention in applying for a US visa, summarize the materials that need to be prepared for applying for a visa, and summarize to Notepad.
Open the Weather app to add Vancouver and monitor its weather, then note down today's climate information in the Notepad.

Search the brand is Nike, the size is XL, about $50 of sports short sleeves in Amazon Shopping, sliding up and down the page, according to store ratings, user reviews and other basis to select three to join the purchase of cars, exit Amazon Shopping and generate the selection of the three stores of the analysis report in Notepad, including the respective advantages and disadvantages of the short sleeves.
Open X and search for 'The Night Circus by Erin Morgenstern', read through one of the posts, then go to eBay, look up the book, and add it to my watchlist.
Take a photo using the Camera, then open TikTok and set it as my profile picture.
Search for keyboards under 100$ on Walmart, take a screenshot, and send it to my WeChat friend Tom.
Find a scrambled eggs with tomatoes cooking tutorial on YouTube, copy the video link, and paste it into the 'My Family' WeChat group.
Open Google Translate, translate '我爱你' to English, and then send the result to my Facebook friend Jerry.
Watch a travel vlog on YouTube and use Google Maps to find the featured location.
